title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site & examples
author: Ava Martinez
description: Add a set of opinionated RAG templates, agent playbooks, and tool-calling quickstarts to make it easier for engineers to prototype retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool-using agents. Motivation: teams keep rebuilding the same boilerplate for document loaders, retrieval pipelines, and agent-tool interfaces; this PR provides curated, easy-to-follow templates and docs to accelerate experimentation and reduce regressions. Changes include: new RAG templates (single-index, multi-index), three agent playbooks (faq-bot, booking-agent, data-explorer) with example tool adapters (search, SQL runner, calendar), TS/Python quickstarts and sample notebooks, and docs site updates (guides, nav, code samples). Checklist: - [x] add RAG templates and playbooks; - [x] add Python and TypeScript quickstarts; - [x] add example tool adapters and tests; - [x] update docs site navigation and guide pages; - [x] add smoke e2e tests for quickstart; - [x] include usage notes and security considerations for external tool access. Related: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4821 and REDWOOD-ops notes in SUP-3412.
